items.title: Active ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs, impact dozens of organizations
items.summary: ConnectWise is investigating an active malware campaign targeting managed service providers (MSPs) that uses compromised ScreenConnect environments to deploy rogue remote-access clients to customer devices.
